en: Black-and-white postcard view over a forested lake or reservoir bordered by conifer trees in the foreground. Across the water a straight dam structure and a small building or house are visible, with a road leading through the woods and gently rolling fields beyond. The scene looks like a man‑made reservoir in a mountainous, heavily forested area. Handwritten-style caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.
